status: evidence-led baseline framework; current site-specific occurrence records and field surveys not yet loaded
warning: Not a complete species inventory. Absence of a published record is not evidence of absence. Sensitive records must remain at source-approved public resolution or be withheld.

vvip.validation: Every public biodiversity record or habitat must match the declared schema and source ID; numerical impact is blocked until source geometry supports the precision.
vvip.verification: Promoter, authority, record-centre, statutory and stakeholder evidence remain separately classified and cross-checkable.
vvip.integrity: No AI-generated species presence, rarity score, habitat polygon or sensitive coordinate may enter the evidence layer.
vvip.provenance: Every public ecological claim must retain source, retrieval date, licence/access rule, evidence class and spatial-precision rule.

evidence_classes.recorded: Occurrence or habitat directly supported by an authoritative/verified dataset or published survey.
evidence_classes.authority-supported-habitat: Council/statutory evidence identifies habitat or ecological constraint; this does not establish every associated species as present.
evidence_classes.survey-target-potential: A competent ecological source states that targeted survey is required or habitat has potential for a species/group.
evidence_classes.source-supported-habitat-use: A source supports ecological use of a habitat/corridor without asserting a precise occurrence point.
evidence_classes.national-standing-advice-context: National planning guidance identifies habitat associations or broad survey windows; this is not a site-specific record or survey result.
evidence_classes.unverified-stakeholder-report: Stakeholder/campaign/media report retained as a verification target only.
